# JigsawDB v1.0.0-beta.8

> [!WARNING]
> **JigsawDB is currently in its public beta release; there may be issues**  
> If you encounter any issues, please report them in our Discord [here](https://discord.gg/nKAZa796ua)

JigsawDB v1.0.0-beta.6 is released to test if the published `javadocs` branch works.  
In terms of actual changes, only shadowTables where added.

## Changelog

- Added shadowTables
    - These are tables which do not get created/modified on startup
- Added a new `javadocs` branch, which automatically publishes javadocs
    - This should now be accessible via https://jigsawdb.blitical.dev
